integrated_multimodal_description: ARRI Alexa 65 anamorphic, organic film grain, 35mm film look.
[Shot 1, 0.0s] Rising slow extreme long shot at 24mm f/4: a Chicago apartment block emerges from cold morning fog, very dim, and in the haze a pick-up headlight punches a warm pool (the hook); distant traffic, deep quiet. [Shot 2, 3.0s] Slow push at 85mm f/1.8 into a lit phone screen reading "DAD": a woman's finger hovers above it, cold screen light on her face, gaze fixed on the name, pupils faintly constricting, breath held. [Shot 3, 6.0s] Static near-shot at 50mm f/2, June holding the phone to her ear in silence, dawn light slicing across her half-shadowed face, brow faintly drawn, eyes lowered evading, lips pressed in a thin line, a swallow; the elderly father's voice comes distant, flat: <d>[English] I drove to Chicago. Come down. I'm taking you to see the Grand Canyon.</d> She asks, guarded, quiet: <d>[English] When did you get here?</d> He answers: <d>[English] Just now.</d> [Shot 4, 10.0s] Panning medium shot at 35mm f/2.8 following her gaze as she draws the curtain, the white vintage pickup (per <Picture 5>) parked in the fog, headlights a small warm pool, a man leaning on the door; her hesitation turns to focus, pupils widening, a breath drawn. [Shot 5, 13.0s] Slow push to a low-angle near-shot at 50mm f/2 of the elderly man (S2) leaning against the door, all-white hair, faded blue work jacket, thinner than she remembered, exhaling a plume of fog; he keeps his eyes down, breathing in puffs, a finger drumming the door.

overall_soundscape: Distant highway traffic through the fog, a ringing phone, brief breaths, then the old man's quiet exhaling and a faint metal tap.

non_diegetic_music: Sparse piano at a slow tempo joined by sustained low strings that swell faintly when the headlight curls of light appear, then settle back.
